en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear, sounds like a modern song, no author I can name. 'Везден да е со тебе' (rendered 'may she be an embroidered one with you') is my reading and likely not accurate; the line may mean something like 'to be always with you'.

words_to_learn.en: from the corner of the eye

lines.cyr: Лична е од полична, баш самовила,
lines.lat: Lična e od polična, baš samovila,
lines.en: She is prettier than pretty, truly a fairy,
made like a dream, a picked bouquet.

lines.cyr: Погледни ја под око, ќе се насмее,
lines.lat: Pogledni ja pod oko, ḱe se nasmee,
lines.en: Glance at her from the corner of your eye, she will smile,

lines.cyr: дофати ја за рака, ќе се распее.
lines.lat: dofati ja za raka, ḱe se raspee.
lines.en: take her by the hand, she will burst into song.

lines.cyr: Само да ја погледаш, ќе ја посакаш,
lines.lat: Samo da ja pogledaš, ḱe ja posakaš,
lines.en: Just look at her, you will desire her,

lines.cyr: везден да е со тебе, да ја милуваш.
lines.lat: vezden da e so tebe, da ja miluvaš.
lines.en: may she be an embroidered one with you, to caress her.
Come on, everyone sing a cheerful song,

lines.cyr: за таа мома убава овде родена.
lines.lat: za taa moma ubava ovde rodena.
lines.en: about that beautiful girl born here.
